findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — `_settled` compares earlier and current findings using raw file and title strings, but this line then folds case and spacing. If review one reports `Defect` and review two reports `defect` in the same file, `_settled` marks the first spelling fixed. On review three, the folded fixed entry filters out the still-present finding, so close can reach Ready. The required identity treats those spellings as one finding.
findings.title: Not done: 2 and 3 — a case-only repeat is treated as fixed and dropped

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — `move` puts fail closed first only when the finding body contains `(floor: security)`. `score.normalise` adds that marker only when it raises a Harm score below 4. A security finding already scored Harm 4 has no marker, so an area stop proposes cutting code first, contrary to the required ordering for an area with a security finding.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done — The later-read prompt includes a disposed note in `$dispositions` only when its text differs from `notes_seen`. A note settled in round one appears there in round two, then disappears from that block in round three if unchanged. Item 3 requires every disposed note, including below-bar notes, in the dispositions block of every later read. The added test inspects only the first later read.
